package_purpose: Anonymous reviewer-facing evidence package for the manuscript's literature-grounded knowledge base section.

source_summary.selection_rule: Keep papers scoring >= 10 on SME + digital transformation + security/capability/prioritization heuristics, plus a small manually curated set of strategic background papers.

files.role: machine-readable retained-paper evidence with theme mapping

blind_review_constraints: No author names or contact information for the manuscript authors
No non-package operational logs or environment details
